citation: This work, computed (UniProt Q496Y0 + AlphaFold AF-Q496Y0-F1-v6)
claim_tested: LONRF3 contains two complete cross-brace RING domains
key_finding: RING1 158-195 and RING2 467-504 both show 8 Zn ligands with cross-brace spacing; AlphaFold Zn-ligand geometry superposes on BIRC7 RING (4AUQ) at 0.61 A (RING1) and 0.67 A (RING2) over the 8 ligand atoms
confidence: High for fold, moderate for function
limitations: AlphaFold models have no zinc ion; fold match does not imply catalysis

claim_tested: A ligand-anchored frame recovers the known E2-binding determinants
key_finding: Positions L2-1, L2+1, L6+4, L7+1 and L8+1 recover the published linchpin Arg in RNF4 R177, BIRC7 R286, CBL R420, RNF38 R504, and the inactive Tyr87 of BARD1
limitations: Frame derived from 4 complexes; RING E3s with non-canonical E2 interfaces may be mis-scored

claim_tested: Which LONRF3 RING carries the catalytic surface
key_finding: RING2 scores 6/6: L469, M471, C494, P502, L503, linchpin K505. RING1 scores 1/6: K160, H162, G185, A193, L194 and Gly196 at the linchpin position

citation: This work, computed (332 human RING proteins, UniProt stream)
key_finding: Of 287 scorable human RING instances, LONRF3 RING2 is at the 74.2nd percentile (6/6, top bin of 74) and RING1 at the 2.1st percentile (1/6). Linchpin R/K present in 60.3%, Pro at L7+1 in 76.0%
limitations: Composite is coarse: active RNF4 scores only 4/6, so the linchpin alone is the stronger single criterion

citation: This work, computed (AlphaFold PAE + pLDDT, AF-Q496Y0-F1-v6)
claim_tested: Is the RING2 E2 face occluded in the full-length model
key_finding: Apparent occlusion (139 clashing atoms onto a docked E2) comes from residues 55-120 and 410-430 placed at PAE 26.2 A with loop pLDDT 25.3; the contact is not supported by the model and was discarded
confidence: High that the occlusion is an artefact
limitations: Does not exclude genuine autoinhibition in the real protein

citation: This work, computed (BIRC7 4AUQ chains B/E dimer reference)
claim_tested: Does RING1 act as an activating partner RING for RING2
key_finding: RING1/RING2 centroid distance 21.3 A versus 21.9 A in the BIRC7 dimer and 1.48 A superposition, but only 6 atom pairs below 5 A versus 105 in the real BIRC7 dimer; a loose juxtaposition, not a dimer interface
limitations: Relative domain placement in AlphaFold multi-domain models is not reliable

citation: This work, computed (UniProt + pairwise Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62)
claim_tested: Is a second RING required for LONRF-family E3 activity
key_finding: LONRF2 (Q1L5Z9, 754 aa) has one RING only, scoring 6/6 at the same frame positions, so the second RING is not a family requirement
limitations: LONRF2 activity itself is annotated, not assayed in this work

claim_tested: Are the RING2 catalytic positions conserved
key_finding: The RING2 linchpin Lys and the four hydrophobic face positions are invariant across the sampled vertebrate LONRF3 orthologs; the RING1 linchpin position is non-R/K throughout
limitations: Ortholog set limited to reviewed and well-annotated UniProt entries

citation: This work, computed (Shrake-Rupley SASA on AF-Q496Y0 LON region)
claim_tested: Is the LON-like region a protease or a substrate-binding module
key_finding: The region matches the LON substrate-binding (N-terminal) domain, has an exposed hydrophobic patch consistent with binding unfolded segments, and carries no Ser-Lys protease dyad and no AAA+ Walker A or B motif
confidence: High for absence of protease and ATPase motifs
limitations: Substrate binding is inferred from surface character, not measured

citation: EBI QuickGO annotation API, retrieved for Q496Y0
claim_tested: What is the current GO evidence for LONRF3 E3 activity
key_finding: GO:0061630 ubiquitin protein ligase activity on LONRF3 is IBA only (GO_REF:0000033); no IDA, IMP or EXP annotation exists. Metal ion binding is IEA from InterPro
limitations: Database state at retrieval date; IBA depends on the reference tree

citation: EBI IntAct findInteractions API, retrieved for Q496Y0
claim_tested: Is there an E2 partner or ubiquitin machinery in the LONRF3 interactome
key_finding: No UBE2 family member, no ubiquitin and no ubiquitin-pathway component appears among the recorded LONRF3 interactions
limitations: Absence in IntAct reflects what has been tested, not what is false

citation: PubMed searches for LONRF3 function, E3, ubiquitin, cancer, methylation (this work)
claim_tested: Is there primary functional literature on human LONRF3
key_finding: No primary paper reports a LONRF3 ubiquitination assay, an E2 partner or a substrate. Searches returned no LONRF3-specific functional study
limitations: PubMed abstract search; a result buried in a proteomics supplement could be missed

key_finding: Detected in all 54 GTEx tissues, so expression gives no tissue-restricted functional lead
limitations: Bulk median TPM; says nothing about activity

citation: Pruneda et al. Mol Cell 2012, PMID 22885007
claim_tested: Is the linchpin residue the determining feature of RING catalysis
key_finding: RING-domain E3s activate E2~Ub by locking the closed conformation; the linchpin residue contacting the E2 backbone is required for transfer
organism_context: In vitro, RNF4 and other RINGs
limitations: Establishes the rule used here; does not address LONRF3
